name: Bojnurd

routes.outcome: Official Bojnurd city-council page states that cadastral mapping of urban lands and registered parcels was being prepared by the registration authority and discusses supplying that information to the municipality. This is local custodian evidence, not a public parcel API.
Official city-council map page exposes population, comprehensive, detailed-plan, district, and satellite map links. It is a municipal map page; no cadastral parcel layer or download was evidenced.

Search result identified the North Khorasan Registration of Deeds and Properties site as the provincial registration authority, but direct access was not usable in this environment; no credentials or bypass was attempted.
Official national Registration of Deeds and Properties host timed out during bounded anonymous GET; no retry escalation, login, or bypass was attempted.
Official registry Shamim host timed out during bounded anonymous GET; no login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA, or bypass was attempted.

Official Iranian Map landing page loaded and linked to public mapping/API documentation, but the documented services are general map/search/routing services and did not expose Bojnurd cadastral parcel geometry or parcel identity.
Secondary report records the national cadastral-survey program and specifically references Bojnurd/North Khorasan, but it is background evidence rather than a source service.

schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: No cadastral parcel geometry response was returned; CRS unresolved.
schemaAndCrs.nativeIdentity: No safe native parcel identity value was returned; no synthetic identity was created.

boundedAnonymousResponse.requestScope: Public official Bojnurd council map page, North Khorasan registry hosts, Shamim host, and general Map.ir documentation

localCustodianAssessment: Local custodian evidence exists: the official Bojnurd city-council record attributes cadastral mapping of city parcels to the Registration of Deeds and Properties authority and discusses coordination with the municipality. The provincial/national registry hosts were not anonymously usable, and no public parcel map/API was evidenced.

qualification.reason: Local cadastral custodian is evidenced, but no anonymous public parcel identity/geometry service was qualified. Runtime adapter admission remains a separate serial review.

No exact-point parcel hit, map extent miss, timeout, or unusable UI was treated as citywide absence.

No GeoJSON sample is retained because no safe full parcel polygon and native parcel identity were returned.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, or personal fields were requested or retained.
Request/search notes and any larger temporary evidence belong under ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/6808/.
TLS verification was not disabled and no certificate exception was used.
uncertainty: Attempt 1 is complete for the queue packet, but public cadastral coverage, API availability, schema/CRS, update cadence, licensing, and runtime adapter behavior remain unresolved. Registry status is true because local official cadastral-custodian evidence was found; this does not imply public API access or source integration.
